name: The 3 Engagement Types
purpose: How the advisor works with the client — teach (Education), work through together (Facilitation), or give expert recommendations (Advice). Derived, not asked. Independent of the staircase / complexity ceiling.

types.name: Education
types.advisorDefinition: Client lacks the knowledge to make informed decisions.
types.deliveryGuidance: Sequential, foundational, build-up logic. Reassure and teach. Never make the client feel judged.
types.note: Client needs some baseline knowledge to even recognise the gap.

types.name: Facilitation
types.advisorDefinition: Client needs to change but is emotionally attached to current behaviour.
types.deliveryGuidance: Pace the reveal. Stay professionally detached. Overwhelming the client causes avoidance or over-assertiveness.
types.note: Needs a visible 6–12 month structured plan the client buys into, or they bail when it gets hard.

types.name: Advice
types.advisorDefinition: Client knows the problem and wants it solved.
types.deliveryGuidance: Direct, expert, outcome-focused. The work is pre-sold — focus on accuracy and a clean outcome.
types.note: Client is ~90% through the buying process; no selling needed.

selection.description: As-built engine logic (strategyResolver.js). Independent of the staircase.
rules: Start from the domain's natural engagement type (domainNaturalEngagement below).
If the client did NOT request help -> force Education.
If advisor confidence is low AND not willing to stretch -> cap at Education.
Firm overrides may replace the computed engagementType.

revisit.decision: Option C — relocate domainNaturalEngagement to a per-domain field in domains.json (single source of truth, kills drift).
revisit.reason: This map is kept here as a convenient INERT snapshot only. Domain names also live in domains.json; holding the engagement assignment in two files risks drift once wired.
revisit.acceptanceCriterion: The Phase-2 wiring task for engagement types is NOT done until each domain carries its own naturalEngagement in domains.json and this block is removed.

designNote.summary: PDF diagnoses engagement type from CLIENT psychological readiness (knowledge gap -> Education; emotional attachment -> Facilitation; ready-to-execute -> Advice). The engine instead starts from a fixed DOMAIN->type map + downgrade gates. The domain map is a heuristic shortcut for the client-readiness diagnosis; a future refinement could use client-readiness signals directly.
designNote.ruleGuard: Engagement type stays independent of the staircase / complexity ceiling (Lens 2 + Lens 4 only).

crossLinks: PDF hierarchy ('start with Education if the client lacks baseline knowledge') independently confirms the education-gates-ascent rule on the Advisory Staircase.
PDF 'Specific Business Event -> Look Both Ways (Pre/Post)' corresponds to the Trial Fit / Cautious Reveal delivery methods already documented in Stage 5.
